sentiment.label: risk_on
sentiment.reason_it: Il VIX a 15.31 (‑6,59%) indica un mercato difensivo ma non in panico; l'S&P 500 è +0,73% a 7.722,72, segno di risk‑on. Il DXY a 102,35 (+0,41%) è leggermente forte, ma l'EUR/USD a 1,11 (‑0,51%) e il Brent a $101,86 (‑0,38%) mostrano pressione sui risk assets. Il TLT 20Y è -0,30% (compressione) e l'oro a $4.161,50 rimane stabile, confermando un contesto di debasement moderato. La guerra in Yemen continua a pesare, ma l'indice Fear & Greed a 70 (Greed) e l'afflusso netto di $3,8 M nel BTC ETF spingono verso un atteggiamento più aggressivo.
sentiment.reason_en: The VIX at 15.31 (‑6.59%) signals a defensive but not panicky market; the S&P 500 is +0.73% at 7,722.72, indicating risk‑on. The DXY at 102.35 (+0.41%) is modestly strong, yet EUR/USD at 1.11 (‑0.51%) and Brent at $101.86 (‑0.38%) show pressure on risk assets. The 20‑year TLT is down 0.30% (compression) and gold at $4,161.50 is flat, confirming a moderate debasement environment. Ongoing war in Yemen adds a bearish drag, but a Fear & Greed index of 70 (Greed) and a $3.8 M net inflow into the BTC ETF tilt the tone toward risk‑on.

market_impact_summary.it: Le azioni globali spingono al rialzo: S&P 500 +0,73%, STOXX 600 +0,77% e FTSE MIB +0,49%. I titoli di Stato USA subiscono compressione (TLT -0,30%) mentre il rendimento 10Y sale a 5,27% (+0,76%). Il petrolio Brent scende a $101,86 (-0,38%) ma resta sopra i $100, segnale di pressione inflazionistica moderata. L'oro è stabile a $4.161,50, mentre il DXY +0,41% indica una leggera preferenza per il dollaro. Il mercato crypto è in fase di greed (indice 70) con BTC +0,91% e un afflusso di $3,8 M nel BTC ETF. Le note settimanali di BlackRock (outlook positivo su equity e liquidità) e Goldman Sachs (focus su opportunità in energia e bond a medio termine) rafforzano il bias risk‑on.
market_impact_summary.en: Global equities are advancing: S&P 500 +0.73%, STOXX 600 +0.77% and FTSE MIB +0.49%. US Treasuries face compression (TLT -0.30%) as the 10Y yield climbs to 5.27% (+0.76%). Brent oil falls to $101.86 (-0.38%) but stays above $100, indicating moderate inflation pressure. Gold is flat at $4,161.50, while the DXY +0.41% shows a slight dollar bias. The crypto market is in greed mode (Fear & Greed 70) with BTC +0.91% and a $3.8 M net inflow into the BTC ETF. Weekly outlooks from BlackRock (positive equity and liquidity stance) and Goldman Sachs (energy and mid‑term bond opportunities) further support the risk‑on tilt.

articles.snippet: The share of gasoline cars in global vehicle sales fell below 50% for the first time ever as the Hormuz shock and the resulting record-high fuel prices accelerated the previously sluggish shift toward EVs outside China. A few years ago, China blew past the threshold of 50% of all car sales being hybrids and EVs, and the share is now about 55%. But the rest of the world didn’t follow until the Iran war disrupted the fuel markets.
